implementation: Round 2 Recovery Manager adapter with charge-level evidence decisions, optional one-call-per-unit model review (Groq by default, same settings as Returns: VLM_API_KEY, VLM_BASE_URL, VLM_MODEL_GROQ), tenancy checks, and fail-open pending outputs
notes: In-process Python adapter; exposes /health and /run through the shared FastAPI factory. Moved from Gemini to the pod's Groq model. As before, the rules decide every charge and the model's reply is not used to change a verdict.
